title: Graph Beta: establish Foundation attempt input authority
description: Graph Beta prerequisite for task-a9fd91c373c244c78df97945965a8038. Resolve, then land, the production authority source for the Foundation dispatch request’s launchTemplate and inputManifest instead of accepting an accidental caller copy. At planning time record the per-field decision “server-derived/durable” versus “caller-proposed but bounded and authenticated” for argv, cwd, environment, bootstrap credential digest, launch selection, limits, runtime observation, base identity, and workspace entries; unresolved fields block rather than default. Measurement at HEAD a42ae2f1f9168d13b8b786404fc47b366cc8edd9: FOUNDATION_ATTEMPT_REQUEST_KEYS requires launchTemplate/inputManifest; packages/runner exports builders and workspace observers, but daemon production has no launch-template producer and its only durable inputManifest reader belongs to the separate sealed foundation-verification aggregate. This task creates the lawful production source/hydration seam. Stage: GRAPH BETA. Not in scope: attempt command registration, current-graph projection, claim/activation, provider dispatch internals, widening effect.activate, or editing the authoritative design.
definitionOfDone: Planning notes record a complete per-field authority matrix for launchTemplate and inputManifest, including why each field is server-derived/durable or caller-proposed; no field is left implicit, and any caller-proposed field has an exact authenticated payload allow-list and bound.

A focused production source/hydrator produces the exact FoundationAttemptLaunchTemplate and WorkspaceInputManifest for a project/session/node using approved durable facts and real runner/host observation surfaces; it never accepts caller-selected grant, runtime closure, slot, budget, lease, attempt, effect, or process-registration authority.

Workspace input is sealed through the production @moe/runner manifest builder against the observed base identity and actual bounded entries, while runtime/launch facts remain tied to server-owned provider capabilities; mismatched base, stale observation, missing workspace, hostile path/argv/environment, or unverifiable runtime fails closed with an exact stable code and layer.

Repeated reads of the same durable identity are byte-stable; conflicting durable/caller-proposed bytes refuse before claim, activation, launch, or process registration and leave zero durable/provider residue.

Focused tests exercise the production source with real durable store and filesystem/host seams, assert exact reason code and layer plus nonzero generated hostile-case counts, include one accepted control, and cover Windows path/argv behavior plus platform-neutral macOS/Linux rejection semantics without shell-normalizing authority.

Completion names task-a9fd91c373c244c78df97945965a8038 as the production consumer and records the exact call-site/dependency edge; daemon typecheck/test and plain-Node provider construction execute with nonzero test evidence.
taskRails: The server-derived versus caller-proposed choice is a Graph Beta authority decision; do not infer it from the existing caller-shaped FoundationAttemptDispatchRequest or silently broaden effect.activate.
Reuse public @moe/runner roots and existing durable/session/provider facts; do not reimplement workspace sealing, runtime observation, or launch selection in daemon tests.
Keep this source/hydration seam separate from Foundation ingress, graph projection, activation, and launch execution.
Fail closed with stable reason codes/layers, use TDD, target <=250 lines per production source and split before 400, preserve foreign work, and commit only explicit owned paths.
